text:
Vim luddites (n.) - modern day luddites insist on writing code by hand on vim, refuse to use modern day IDE like VScode or AI coding agents like Claude Code.

one interesting observation, I don't see any emacs luddites.  maybe the LISP root to emacs makes the emacs user more open to AI.  LISP was OG AI after all.

replies.text: Matthew Ballance I'll chime in here and say, that makes you...smart! 😊😂😉

comments.text:
I treat Claude/AI like a new generation compiler which provides you much higher level abstraction and frees you from writing a syntactically correct code to atleast well defined small blocks.
I think the SW world already have frameworks for boilerplate creation.

DV Engineers have no choice but to adopt new paradigm otherwise risk losing on productivity.It can also help with portable stimulus code optimized for many disparate platforms including HW assisted verification.
